g.title: KEYCABLE
g.text: key motor cable (supplied with the motor)
plug it into the E0 motor header. Shorten only if the key's StallGuard reads too dull (bench stage 5).

g.title: PIGTAIL
g.text: UART pigtail — 6 F-F jumpers, one end cut off each
each lead keeps a female Dupont end; cut to measured length + a few cm

g.title: SPLICE
g.text: solder + heat shrink, zip-tied to the deck. R1 1 kΩ sits in line in the TX2 lead (since revision 2026-10-08.2; drawing revision 2026-10-09.1)

g.title: RX_X
g.text: X driver, top of its RX pin (4th from EN)

g.title: RX_Y
g.text: Y driver, top of its RX pin (4th from EN)

g.title: RX_Z
g.text: Z driver, top of its RX pin (4th from EN)

g.title: RX_E0
g.text: E0 driver, top of its RX pin (4th from EN)
